facts.text: Historical sources include material, written and oral sources; sources based on modern technology such as audio, video and audio-visual are also included.
facts.quote: Historical sources include material, written and oral sources. Similarly sources based on modern technology such as audio, video and audio-visual are included.

facts.text: Various objects, monuments, places, coins, sculptures etc. can be included in the material sources of history.
facts.quote: Various objects, monuments, places, coins, sculptures etc. can be included in the material sources of history.

facts.text: The period of Modern Indian History is believed to be the period of European, especially British, rulers and governance of Princely States.
facts.quote: The period of Modern Indian History is believed as period of European, especially the British rulers, and governance of Princely States.

facts.text: In this period buildings, bridges, roads, water supply systems, fountains etc. were built, including government offices, palaces of rulers of princely states, forts and prisons.
facts.quote: In this period various buildings, bridges, roads, water supply system, fountains etc. were built. These buildings include government offices, residences of officers, leaders and revolutionaries; palaces of rulers of princely states, forts, prisons etc.

facts.text: Some of these buildings are declared national monuments and some are converted into museums, for example the Cellular Jail in Andaman.
facts.quote: Some are declared as national monuments, where as some are converted into museum. For eg. Cellular Jail in Andaman.

facts.text: A visit to the Cellular Jail in Andaman gives information about the revolutionary work of V.D.Savarkar.
facts.quote: during the visit to Cellular jail in Andaman we get information about the revolutionary work of V.D.Savarkar

facts.text: Visiting Manibhavan in Mumbai or Sevagram Ashram at Wardha gives information about the history of the Gandhian era.
facts.quote: by visiting Manibhavan in Mumbai or Sevagram Ashram at Wardha we get information about the history of Gandhian era.

facts.text: At the Aga Khan Palace in Pune we can see objects and documents giving information about the life of Mahatma Gandhi.
facts.quote: At the Aga Khan Palace in Pune, we can see different objects, documents giving information about the life of Mahatma Gandhi.

facts.text: Objects, paintings, photographs and such other things are preserved in a museum for the study of history.
facts.quote: For the study of History various objects, paintings, photographs and such other things are preserved in a museum.

facts.text: The display plaque on a statue gives the full name of the person, birth and death details, brief information about their contribution and a biographical sketch.
facts.quote: The display plaque on the statues gives us information about the full name of the concerned person, birth and death details, brief information about their contribution and a biographical sketch of the person.

facts.text: Statues of Mahatma Jyotirao Phule, Lokmanya Tilak and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar are examples of statues erected as memorials.
facts.quote: Just as the statues of Mahatma Jyotirao Phule, Lokmanya Tilak, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, there are memorials

facts.text: Some memorials are erected in the memory of events, for example the Hutatma Smarak at various places.
facts.quote: there are memorials which are erected in the memory of various events ... For e.g. Hutatma Smarak at various places.

facts.text: Written sources include correspondence, foreign accounts, newspapers, biographies, periodicals, factory records, autobiographies and books.
facts.quote: Correspondence, Foreign Accounts, Newspapers, Biographies ... Periodicals, Factory Records, Autobiographies, Books

facts.text: Before independence, newspapers like Dnyanoday, Dnyanprakash, Amrit Bazaar Patrika, Deenbandhu and Kesari were an important source of awakening the minds of the people.
facts.quote: In the pre independence period, newspapers like Dnyanoday, Dnyanprakash, Amrit Bazaar Patrika, Deenbandhu, Kesari acted as important source of awakening the minds of the people.

facts.text: During the British period, newspapers were a source of political events and also a source of social reformation.
facts.quote: During the British period, newspapers were not only the source of political events but also acted as a source of social reformation.

facts.text: The 'Nibandhmala' by Vishnushastri Chiplunkar comments on social and cultural issues.
facts.quote: The 'Nibandhmala' by Vishnushastri Chiplunkar and Shatapatre ... comments on various social and cultural issues.

facts.text: Shatapatre was written by Lokahitawadi alias Gopal Hari Deshmukh in the weekly 'Prabhakar'.
facts.quote: Shatapatre written by Lokahitawadi alias Gopal Hari Deshmukh in the weekly 'Prabhakar' comments on various social and cultural issues.

facts.text: In January 1920, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar started the fortnightly 'Mooknayak'.
facts.quote: In January 1920, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar started the fortnightly 'Mooknayak'.

facts.text: Dr. Ambedkar left for higher studies to England and handed over 'Mooknayak' to his colleagues.
facts.quote: Dr. Ambedkar had to leave for higher studies to England and hence he handed over this paper to his colleagues.

facts.text: In April 1927, Dr. Ambedkar started the newspaper 'Bahishkrut Bharat'.
facts.quote: In April 1927, Dr. Ambedkar started the newspaper 'Bahishkrut Bharat'.

facts.text: Through 'Bahishkrut Bharat' Dr. Ambedkar wrote for the reformation of common people and bringing unity among them.
facts.quote: Through the medium of Bahishkrut Bharat he wrote for the reformation of common people and bringing unity among them.

facts.text: Dr. Ambedkar also started two more newspapers, 'Janata' and 'Prabuddha Bharat'.
facts.quote: Apart from this he also started two more newspapers, namely, 'Janata' and 'Prabuddha Bharat'.

facts.text: Maps are an important source of history; the changing nature of a city or a location can be traced through maps.
facts.quote: Map is also regarded as an important source of history. The changing nature of a city or a particular location can be traced through maps.

facts.text: The Survey of India was an independent department established during the British period; it created maps of India, provinces and cities through scientific methods of survey.
facts.quote: The Survey of India was an independent department established during the British period. Through scientific methods of survey, they have created maps of India, various provinces of India, cities etc.

facts.text: The Department of Mumbai Port Trust has the original plan of the Bombay Port; plans by architects and engineers show the development of Bombay city.
facts.quote: the Department of Mumbai Port Trust has the original plan of the Bombay Port. Information about development of Bombay city can be understood through the plans drafted by architects and engineers.

facts.text: Oral sources include folk songs, Powada, folk tales, narrations, interviews, fairs, Jalsa and art groups, rythmic prose (Ovee) and inspirational songs.
facts.quote: Folk songs, Powada, Folk Tales, Narrations, Interviews, Fairs, Jalsa, Art Groups, Rythmic prose (Ovee), Inspirational Songs

facts.text: Inspirational songs were composed during the freedom movement; many unpublished ones were memorised by freedom fighters.
facts.quote: During the period of freedom movement various inspirational songs were composed. ... there are many other unpublished inspirational songs memorised by freedom fighters.

facts.text: Powadas were composed on the freedom struggle of 1857 and the valour of revolutionaries during British rule; they created motivation and spirit among the people.
facts.quote: There are various Powadas composed on freedom struggle of 1857, valour of revolutionaries during British rule etc. These Powadas were used to create motivation and spirit among the people.

facts.text: Powadas were also composed on the work of Satyashodhak Samaj for awakening among the oppressed classes and on the Samyukta Maharashtra movement.
facts.quote: the Powadas were composed based on the work of Satyashodhak Samaj for awakening among the oppressed classes, the Samyukta Maharashtra movement and such other events.

facts.text: Photographs are a visual source; the authenticity of mediaeval paintings is doubtful, and photographs are considered more reliable.
facts.quote: Photographs are visual source of modern Indian history. ... the authenticity of these paintings is doubtful. Comparatively photographs are considered to be more reliable.

facts.text: The photograph of a person gives information about physical features and dressing style.
facts.quote: The photograph of a person gives information about the physical features, dressing style etc.

facts.text: Recording is a form of audio source of history; speeches of leaders and songs are available as recordings.
facts.quote: Recording is a form of audio source of history. During modern period, the speeches of leaders or important personalities, songs etc are available in the form of recordings.

facts.text: The National anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' sung by Rabindranath Tagore himself and the speeches of Subhash Chandra Bose can be used as audio sources.
facts.quote: National anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' sung by Rabindranath Tagore himself or the speeches of Subhash Chandra Bose can be used as an audio source

facts.text: Films are considered a unique discovery of modern technology; in the 20th century filmmaking developed greatly.
facts.quote: Films are considered as a unique discovery of modern technology. In the 20th century, there was a great development in the technique of filmmaking.

facts.text: Dada Saheb Phalke laid the foundation of the Indian film industry in 1913.
facts.quote: Dada Saheb Phalke, in the year 1913, laid the foundation of Indian film industry.

facts.text: Audio visual recordings of Dandi Yatra, Salt Satyagraha and the Quit India Movement are available.
facts.quote: Audio visual recording of Dandi Yatra, Salt Satyagraha, Quit India Movement and such other historical incidents are available.

facts.text: Compared to the ancient and mediaeval period, sources of modern Indian history are found in abundance and variety; archaeological sources are in a better state and many written sources are preserved in archives.
facts.quote: Compared to ancient and mediaeval period, the sources of study of modern Indian history are found in abundance and variety. The archaeological sources of this period are to a great extent found in a better state. There are many written sources preserved in the archives.

facts.text: While referring to written sources, the ideology and opinions of the author need to be examined.
facts.quote: while referring the written sources, the ideology and opinions of the author regarding the particular event needs to be examined.
